title: Headless Execution Input Fingerprint
description: Input identity captured before dispatch or report compaction, not authentication or scientific qualification. SHA-256 over UTF-8 schema_version followed by one NUL byte and sorted-key compact JSON of the effective execution batch with warnings replaced by an empty array. Numbers use lossless serde_json number serialization, not legacy TaskIR decimal rounding. Arrays preserve order; absent template_id remains absent.
